description: Source code for an echo client application running on Zephyr OS, implementing network communication with TCP/UDP, TLS, and event handling.

methods.name: prepare_fds
methods.description: Prepares the file descriptor array for polling based on active sockets.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for events on any socket using poll.

methods.name: start_udp_and_tcp
methods.description: Starts UDP and TCP services if enabled.

methods.name: run_udp_and_tcp
methods.description: Processes UDP and TCP events if active.

methods.name: event_handler
methods.description: Handles network connection and disconnection events.

methods.name: init_app
methods.description: Initializes application, including TLS credentials, event callbacks, and network setup.

methods.name: start_client
methods.description: Main client loop that manages connection and data sending.
